title: Checking Out and Clarifying a Price
context: 顾客 Amy 在超市收银台发现一盒麦片扫描价高于货架标价。收银员 Leo 核实标价后修改价格，Amy 核对新价格并刷卡付款。

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: The cereal scanned at six dollars, but I saw five dollars on the shelf.
dialogue.zh: 这盒麦片扫出来是六美元，但我在货架上看到的是五美元。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Let me check the shelf label for that cereal.
dialogue.zh: 我来核对一下那款麦片的货架标签。

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: Thank you. It was the label under the large box.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。标签在大盒麦片的下面。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: I checked it. The label does say five dollars for this box.
dialogue.zh: 我查过了。标签上这盒确实是五美元。

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: Could you change the price, please?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Yes. I have changed it from six dollars to five.
dialogue.zh: 可以。我已经从六美元改成五美元了。

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: I can see five dollars on the screen now. Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 我现在看到屏幕上是五美元了。谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: You are welcome. That is the last item.
dialogue.zh: 不客气。这是最后一件商品。

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: Can I pay with a card?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Yes. Please insert your card in the reader.
dialogue.zh: 可以。请把卡插入读卡器。

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: The payment went through. May I have a receipt?
dialogue.zh: 付款成功了。我可以要一张收据吗？

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Of course. Here is your receipt. Have a good day.
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。这是你的收据。祝你今天愉快。

expressions.zh: 扫描显示为某个价格；用于描述收银机上的价格。
expressions.example: This item scanned at six dollars.

expressions.zh: 货架标签；可用来指明看到的标价。
expressions.example: Could you check the shelf label?

expressions.zh: 修改价格；询问收银员能否更正时使用。
expressions.example: Could you change the price, please?

expressions.zh: 刷卡付款；询问付款方式。
expressions.example: Can I pay with a card?

expressions.zh: 成功完成；付款时表示交易已成功。

pronunciation: price /praɪs/ 和 receipt /rɪˈsiːt/ 都有清晰的 /s/；receipt 中的 p 不发音，重音在第二音节。练习 shelf label 时分别读清两个词的开头。

practice.title: Part 1 · Shopping
practice.prompt: Do you check prices when you shop for food?
practice.answer: Yes. I compare prices on the shelf and look at the screen at checkout. It helps me notice a mistake.

practice.title: Part 2 · A shopping experience
practice.prompt: Describe a time you checked a price while shopping. Say what you bought, what you noticed, and what happened.
practice.answer: I bought a box of cereal at a supermarket near my home. At checkout, I noticed that the screen showed a higher price than the shelf label. I told the cashier what I had seen and asked her to check. She looked at the label and changed the price. I checked the screen again, paid by card, and thanked her for her help. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Prices in shops
practice.prompt: Why is it useful for stores to show prices clearly?
practice.answer: Clear prices help customers decide what to buy and plan their spending. They also make it easier for staff and customers to notice and correct mistakes.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先逐句跟读，再扮演顾客说明货架价与扫描价不同，请对方核对并确认付款方式。
practice.answer: 用 4–6 句练习；同伴扮演收银员，核对并告知修改后的价格。
